sentences.text:
The grievance of the petitioner is that, based on Ext.P7 proceedings of the Food Safety Commissioner,
the learned Magistrate is not proceeding with RC No.149/2022.
Therefore, this Writ Petition is filed with a prayer to issue appropriate direction to the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kozhikode to accept Ext.P3 and close RC No.149/2022.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kozhikode
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
4.
This Court perused Ext.P7 letter of the Food Safety Commissioner.

It will be better to extract the same:
"  .     
23/12/24        2025:KER:58906     .  
    
 ."
5. This letter is send to a Judicial First Class Magistrate Court by a Food Safety Commissioner.
I am of the considered opinion that the Food Safety Commissioner has no authority to dictate to a Magistrate Court not to close the referred case till a decision is taken by the Government.
The tone and tenor of the letter is to be deprecated.

Therefore, when this case came up for consideration on 14.07.2025, this Court passed the following order:
"The learned Public Prosecutor will get an explanation from the Food Safety Commissioner, how he issued Ext.P7 letter to the Judicial First Class Magistrate-I,
Kozhikode, which, according to me, prima facie contemptuous.
2025:KER:58906

The Registry will get a report from the Judicial First Class Magistrate-I, Kozhikode to find out why no further steps are taken in RC No.149/2022 and if it is based on Ext.P7, which is not binding to the Magistrate.
The Magistrate will give an explanation to the same."
6. The learned Magistrate submitted a report.
The same is extracted hereunder:

"In obedience to reference cited above, I may respectfully submit that the Station House Officer filed a refer report in Crime No. 703/19 of Chevayoor police Station on Subburaj M vs State Of Kerala on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18824555/
3 24.02.2022 and a notice was issued to the Food Safety Commissioner, the complainant of this case.

sentences.text: But notice served only on 23/12/2024.

The same day, the Food Safety Commissioner, the complainant of this case, filed a letter NO.CFS/781/2022-G dated 12.12.2024 stating that the proceedings in this case should not be disposed of until a final decision from the government is obtained.
The case was posted to 03.03.2025 for awaiting further steps, if any.

On 03.03.2025,
the complainant was absent and there was no 2025:KER:58906 representation, case was posted to 03.05.2025, 24.06.2025 and 03.09.2025 respectively.
It is humbly submitted that, I joined this office on 18.5.2025.
The case was already posted for report on the basis of the letter received from food safety commissioner.

From 3.3.25 onwards, the case was adjourned to 3.5.25 and to 24.6.25 before I joined this office on 24.6.25, I, in continuation to the earlier proceedings, posted the case for report on a wrong notion, inadvertently.
I hereby apologize for the same and I hereby undertake that the case will be proceeded further forthwith.
The delay occurred in considering the above case was not deliberate or willful and hence the error may be excused by your goodself."
7. When the case came up for consideration on 25.07.2025, the Public Prosecutor seeks further time to get instruction from the Food Safety Commissioner.
Today, the Public Prosecutor submitted that the officer concerned regret for submitting such a letter before a Magistrate Court.
I am of the considered opinion that if a matter is pending before the Government, a request should be made to the Magistrate to keep in abeyance the proceedings for some time.
The Food Safety Commissioner cannot direct the Magistrate not to pass final orders in a case referred by the Police till a decision is taken by the Government.
Considering the regret submitted by the Food Safety Commissioner, I am of the opinion that further action is not necessary.

In the light of the report submitted by the learned Magistrate, which is extracted above, there can be a direction to the learned Magistrate to pass final orders in RC No.149/2022 forthwith, especially because it is a final report submitted by the police in the year 2022.

Therefore, this Original Petition(Crl.) is disposed of with the following directions:
1.

The Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, 2025:KER:58906 Kozhikode is directed to pass appropriate orders in RC No.149/2022, as expeditiously as possible,
at any rate, within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this Judgment.
